verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Default Runbook attaches to every incident and always includes an "Assign a Role" step that makes the incident opener the Commander, plus an "Add Task List" step. Runbooks trigger conditionally per incident and can be tailored to different situations and teams. Together these give documented incident roles and task checklists, though the role catalog and checklist mechanics are only briefly described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of additional roles such as comms lead or custom role definitions, detail on how task checklists are built and tracked during an incident, independent or hands-on corroboration.
